data: In the first graph, which classes reach a constant accuracy very early?

The left graph shows the learning curve for CNN+PROTO. The red line represents the performance on seen classes, while the blue line represents the performance on unseen classes. The red line reaches a constant accuracy very early, around 100 tasks seen during training. In contrast, the blue line for unseen classes continues to fluctuate and does not reach a constant accuracy until later in the training process. Therefore, the seen classes reach a constant accuracy very early in the first graph.
